answer: Registered rabbi ordination record with rabbinical assembly verification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 679 pays 9506 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One opal of signal, one reef of cost, one echo of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
